title: Learning Multi-Humanoid Pickup and Transport via Decentralized Object-Centric Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.17824v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study cooperative multi-humanoid pickup and transport of objects with varying size, weight, and geometry, requiring robot teams of different sizes. Our approach uses decentralized object-centric control, where each humanoid is assigned a local attachment region on the shared object and learns to realize pickup and transport through gripperless bimanual pinching. This attachment-based interface provides a common control abstraction spanning single-robot pickup, cooperative multi-robot transport, and robot-to-robot handover, without per-task redesign. We find that policies trained only on single-robot pickup already transfer nontrivially to cooperative settings, suggesting that this abstraction captures much of the structure needed for coordination. translated_title: 基于去中心化以物体为中心的控制学习多人形机器人协作拾取与搬运
translated_abstract: 我们研究了多人形机器人协作拾取和搬运具有不同尺寸、重量和几何形状的物体，这需要不同规模的机器人团队。我们的方法采用去中心化的以物体为中心的控制，每个人形机器人被分配共享物体上的一个局部附着区域，并通过无夹爪的双臂捏取学习实现拾取和搬运。这种基于附着的接口提供了一个通用的控制抽象，涵盖单机器人拾取、协作多机器人搬运以及机器人之间的交接，无需针对每个任务进行重新设计。我们发现，仅在单机器人拾取上训练的策略已经能够有效地迁移到协作场景中，这表明该抽象捕捉了协调所需的大部分结构。同时，显式的多机器人训练进一步提高了性能，表明共享物体耦合引入了值得直接学习的协调动态。
tldr: 该论文提出去中心化的以物体为中心控制方法，通过为每个人形机器人分配物体上的局部附着区域，利用基于附着的通用控制抽象，使机器人团队能够协作完成拾取、搬运和交接任务，且单机器人训练的策略可迁移至协作场景，显式多机器人训练能进一步提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decentralized object-centric control method where each humanoid is assigned a local attachment region on a shared object, enabling a common control abstraction for pickup, cooperative transport, and robot-to-robot handover, with single-robot policies transferring to cooperative settings and explicit multi-robot training further improving performance.
